part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `isCaddyfile` (cmd/main.go:137): an over-eager check from #6362 returned an "ambiguous config file format" error for any config starting with "Caddyfile" that had an extension (e.g. `.serve/Caddyfile.preview`), even though per the docs the caddyfile adapter should be assumed whenever the filename starts with "Caddyfile".

The fix removes the ambiguous-error branch and the now-unused `extNotCaddyfileOrJSON` variable, so `adapterName == "" && startsOrEndsInCaddyfile` simply returns true; JSON files are still excluded, and an explicit non-caddyfile adapter still returns false. This matches upstream PR #6370.

Verification: `go build ./cmd/` succeeds and `go test ./cmd/` passes, including all 9 `Test_isCaddyfile` cases that were failing before.
